programme.desc: Ivan Locke (Tom Hardy) is one of the best civil engineers in England.He has just finished working on a construction site in Birmingham and is driving to London, where he lives.Tomorrow is the most important day of his career so far, and it is related to the project of a gigantic apartment building.While traveling home, Ivan receives one phone call that completely changes his life... Tom Hardy and Steven Knight had already met during the production of the second season of the series about English gangs of the 1920s, entitled"Peaky Blinders".Hardy played the boss of a Jewish gang, Alfie Salomons, and Knight co-wrote the script.

programme.title: On Swift Horses
programme.desc: 1950s. Newlyweds Muriel (Daisy Edgar-Jones) and Lee (Will Poulter) move from Kansas to San Diego, where a new home and job awaits them.At this time, the man's brother, Julius (Jacob Elordi), who has just returned from the Korean War, reappears in their lives.The former veteran is an accomplished poker player.So he goes to Las Vegas, where he supervises a casino and becomes friends with another gaming enthusiast, Henry (Diego Calva).All this time, she corresponds by letter with her sister-in-law.The woman, bored with her everyday life, is fascinated by the world of gambling in which her brother-in-law operates.Under his influence, he secretly begins betting on horse races.She soon leaves her husband and sets off on an exciting journey together with his brother.

programme.desc: Nora (Noée Abita) is 26 years old and has recently graduated from law school.She is just assigned her first criminal case, which turns out to be a plunge into the deep end.While in custody, he meets his client, a 19-year-old boy accused of murdering his neighbor.Even though it looks like everyone has already passed judgment on him, she has a lot of doubts.Gradually, through this case, Nora becomes aware of the cruelty of the world around her.He also makes many mistakes that make him start to doubt his life choices.

programme.title: Long Good Thursday

programme.title: The Last Vermeer
programme.desc: The Netherlands after World War II.The accountability of Nazi criminals and their accomplices continues.A Jew, Joseph Piller (Claes Bang), who fought in the resistance movement, is to deal with the case of stolen works of art.He accuses the eccentric painter Han van Meegeren (Guy Pearce) of collaboration, who hosted Germans at his hedonistic parties and sold them valuable paintings.The artist faces a death sentence.However, he claims that he traded in fakes he created.His exquisitely crafted fakes are indistinguishable from the originals.Although the evidence points to van Meegeren's guilt, and accepting his version would make the brilliant forger a national hero, Piller begins to believe him.Together with her assistant (Vicky Krieps), she tries to prove his innocence, putting her career and good name on the line.Based on facts, the extraordinary story of a Dutch painter and one of the best art forgers in history.It was based on the biography of Han van Meegeren by Jonathan Lopez.

programme.title: Warcraft
programme.desc: The Orcs face extinction when their homeworld, Draenor, is torn apart by a mysterious force.In this situation, the sorcerer Gul'dan unites the clans into the Horde and then opens a portal to the land of Azeroth.He leads a small battle group through the gate.Powerful creatures attack human-inhabited territory.The ruler of the invaded land asks the magician Medivh to help him defeat giant creatures.The king's brother-in-law, the brave knight Anduin Lothar, also sets off to fight the unequal fight against the intruders.Soon, the magician Khadgar discovers that the invaders managed to open a passage between the worlds thanks to the support of one of the people.To save the country from destruction, the daredevils must find the traitor as quickly as possible.

programme.title: Good Guy With A Gun
programme.desc: After the violent death of his father, teenage Will (Beck Nolan) and his mother, Tessa Greenwood (Tiffany Bedwell), move to a small town in Illinois.There is a house they inherited from an ancestor, which the woman intends to sell.There, Will meets boys his own age and quickly becomes friends with them.The new friends are fascinated by the weapons each of them has and spend time practicing their shooting skills.Will begins to share their passion, which even worsens his already not good relationship with his mother, complicates the mourning for his father, and even puts the boy's life in danger.

programme.title: Drazen
programme.desc: 1970s.Teenage Dražen Petrovic (Tonko Stosic) living in Šibenik discovers, thanks to his older brother, Aleksander (Lovre Tanfara), that he has a talent for playing basketball.At first, he trained only with him or alone - in the evenings in the gym.When his abilities are noticed at school, he joins the local team, Šibenka, where he is successful.During this time, he falls in love with Renata (Romina Tonkovic).Over time, a talented young man (Domagoj Nizic) goes to a club in Zagreb and then abroad, among others.to Real Madrid, and finally received an offer to play with the New York Brooklyn Nets team, part of the NBA league.Unfortunately, Dražen's passion for basketball also becomes his curse, and success is associated with problems in his personal life, also in his relationship with Renata.A biographical story about the outstanding Croatian athlete, called the Mozart of basketball, who was the first European to play in the NBA.

programme.title: The Huntsman: Winter's War
programme.desc: Many years before Snow White's birth, Queen Ravenna (Charlize Theron) observes the actions of her sister, Freya (Emily Blunt), who is in love with a man named Andrew.Soon their daughter is born.Shortly thereafter, the child is murdered.At the same time, Freya discovers that she has the power to control ice.The woman leaves Ravenna's lands with a broken heart.He creates his own kingdom and an army of deadly hunters.There is only one rule in their ranks: never to love.It is broken by two warriors - Eric (Chris Hemsworth) and Sara (Jessica Chastain).Freya decides to separate them.Seven years later, after Ravenna's death, Snow White decides to get rid of the evil queen's mirror, moving it to the sanctuary.Some time later, William informs Eric that the soldiers who were responsible for the expedition have gone missing.The hunter suspects Freya - the mirror could significantly increase her power.He agrees to complete the mission, with the help of the dwarves.

programme.desc: 1980s. The life of bullied teenage Niall (Mitchell Robertson) turns upside down when the son of his mother's partner, the fierce and unpredictable Ruben (Stuart Campbell), comes to live with them for a while.Even though they are not related by blood, over time they both become inseparable.However, subsequent events make them move away from each other.Three decades later, Ruben (Richard Gadd) shows up uninvited at Niall's (Jamie Bell) wedding.It soon becomes clear why he reconnected with his long-lost brother.A suggestive story about the fragility of male relationships, brotherhood, betrayal, loyalty and violence.

programme.title: House of the Dragon 2
programme.desc: The second series of the production, the events of which precede the action of "Game of Thrones".After the death of Lucerys Velaryon, the son of Queen Rhaenyra Targaryen (Emma D'Arcy), which was caused by his cousin, Aemond Targaryen (Ewan Mitchell), Westeros finds itself on the brink of a bloody civil war.The Green Council supporting King Aegon (Tom Glynn-Carney) and Queen Rhaenyra's Black Council are fighting for influence.Each side claims the Iron Throne.The dynamic development of events also affects the attitude of Rhaenyra's husband, Daemon (Matt Smith), in life.A man who spends a lot of time in Harrenhal Castle, away from his wife, changes a lot.In addition, the demons of his past begin to haunt him.

programme.title: 28 Days Later...
programme.desc: A deadly virus was bred in one of the laboratories in Great Britain.A group of animal activists breaks in and frees the monkeys that were being studied.The animals, mad with rage, attack their saviors.The infected person loses control within 12 seconds and becomes a bloodthirsty beast.The epidemic is spreading extremely quickly throughout the country.28 days later, Jim (Cillian Murphy) wakes up from a coma while lying in the intensive care unit of a London hospital.Not understanding what happened, he wanders the deserted streets of the city.The terrified man is attacked by groups of angry people.He is saved from trouble by Selena (Naomie Harris) and Mark (Noah Huntley).All three escape from the city and end up at a military base commanded by Major Henry West (Christopher Eccleston).However, they are not safe there either.

programme.title: What a Feeling
programme.desc: Austria.Doctor Marie Theres Wallner (Caroline Peters) is 52 years old and has been married to Alexander (Heikko Deutschmann) for two decades, with whom she raises teenage Anna (Allegra Tinnefeld).Her previously successful life falls apart when her husband suddenly leaves her.Desperate, she goes to a bar where she meets a confident, independent immigrant from Iran, Fa Safir (Proschat Madani), who runs a carpentry business with her siblings.Even though the women are very different from each other, something attracts them to each other.If they want to be happy, they must free themselves from many limitations.

programme.title: Hitch
programme.desc: Alex Hitchens experienced heartbreak years ago.He decided that he would never fall in love again, but at the same time he decided to serve other men and share with them his knowledge about women's nature.Since then, he has been involved in a rather unusual profession - advising on how to seduce girls.He prides himself on the fact that he can turn every client into a reliable, self-confident pickup artist.Makes every effort to maintain anonymity.Despite this, he easily obtains subsequent lucrative orders.Hitchens' new client is a humble accountant named Albert, who has fallen in love with the beautiful heiress of a fortune, Allegra Cole.She feels that she has no chance because of her overweight and shyness.Alex meets journalist Sara, who is supposed to interview Allegra.He falls in love with her at first sight.It turns out that in this case his methods fail.As he gradually gains Sara's affection, she discovers his shameful secret...

programme.title: Trolls
programme.desc: Trolls are cheerful, singing and fabulously colorful creatures that live in a colorful forest.None of them have any idea what the world around them is like.Poppy displays their positive attitude the most.Her carefreeness and joy is shared by everyone, except Mruk.The troll believes that his brethren are in danger.These words come true when the village of nice creatures is found by their greatest enemies, the Bergens.All of Poppy's friends are kidnapped and she must set out to rescue them.She is accompanied by Mruk, who is reluctant to leave his home.In the Polish language version, the characters were voiced by, among others: Magdalena Wasylik, Piotr Bajtlik, Ewa Konstancja Bułhak and Bartosz Obuchowicz.

programme.title: Uncharted
programme.desc: New York.Young Nathan Drake (Tom Holland), a descendant of the explorer Francis Drake, works as a bartender in an upscale establishment where he does not hesitate to rob his wealthy customers from time to time.At the same time, the boy believes that he knows where the legendary Eldorado is.One day, he is visited at a bar by experienced treasure hunter Victor "Sully" Sullivan (Mark Wahlberg).The man invites the boy to participate in an expedition to find the treasure of the Portuguese sailor Ferdinand Magellan, who was lost 500 years ago.Together they set off on a crazy and adventurous journey.It soon turns out that they have to hurry, because the ruthless Santiago Moncada (Antonio Banderas) and the mercenary Jo Braddock (Tati Gabrielle) are also looking for the valuables.In addition, the travelers try to find Nathan's missing brother, and because it is sometimes difficult for them to communicate, they learn to cooperate.A spectacular adaptation of a popular video game.

programme.title: King Charles III
programme.desc: After the death of Elizabeth II, her son Charles (Tim Pigott-Smith) takes over power in Great Britain.During his first meeting with Prime Minister Tristan Evans (Adam James), he learns about the draft law regulating the rights of the press, which has already been adopted by both the House of Commons and the House of Lords and is only awaiting the king's consent.Charles refuses to sign it, fearing that the new law will limit press freedom and allow the government to use censorship.Then, due to the prime minister's threat to introduce the law without royal consent, he dissolves parliament.Soon a wave of protests begins to sweep across the country, with the most violent taking place in London.The difficult situation at Buckingham Palace is not improved by a sex scandal involving the ruler's younger son, Prince Henry (Richard Goulding), related to the publication of compromising photos of him with his lover, Jessica (Tamara Lawrance).Charles's older son, William (Oliver Chris), and his wife Catherine (Charlotte Riley) also do not support the king.The young man accuses his father of causing the crisis and demands that he abdicate.A film version of Mike Bartlett's play of the same title.The author is also the author of the script for this production.

programme.title: River Wild
programme.desc: Idaho.Doctor Joey (Leighton Meester) goes to meet Brother Gray (Taran Killam), who is organizing a rafting trip on the Salmon River.There he meets his long-time friend Trevor (Adam Brody), who is on parole, and two young women.Initially, the rafting takes place in a relaxed atmosphere.Everything changes on their first night together, when the kayakers set up camp.One of the young women suffers serious injuries.The circumstances of the incident are unclear, and the injured party herself claims that she was the victim of an attack.The incident disturbs the peace of Joey and the other participants of the expedition.However, it turns out that this is only the beginning of the problems.

programme.title: Towards the sun
programme.desc: The year 2057. People are increasingly concerned about what is happening to the Sun.It seems to be losing power, and the Earth dependent on it is gradually becoming covered with ice.Scientists are sending an expedition towards the Sun whose task is to place a powerful nuclear charge on its surface.Experts predict that such an explosion will stimulate the star's activity and thus save the world from destruction.After some time, however, it turns out that a similar mission had already taken place seven years earlier, but then none of the crew managed to return to Earth.This time, eight people are sent into space, commanded by the experienced Captain Kaneda.The Icarus II board includes, among others:Cassie, Capa, Corazon and Mace.It quickly turns out that someone is making every effort to prevent the expedition members from reaching their goal.Soon, one of the pilots makes a fatal mistake and deprives the crew of oxygen supplies.In addition, unexpectedly, the ship begins to receive warning signals from its predecessor.The situation is becoming more and more dramatic.
